identity: W F(x) + b == (W diag(g)) [diag(1/g) F(x)] + b for nonzero channel DC gain g
interpretation: Input gain can be absorbed into first-projection weight columns for a fixed learned filter. Gain is not independent representational capacity. Optimization/regularization effects and temporal filtering still require controlled comparisons.
limitation: Projection-only algebra/numerical check, not proof of identical spiking trajectories under floating-point perturbations or fresh-model generalization.
required_future_control: Fresh gain-only parameter-matched control against FIR on the primary development pair before a timing-specific claim; never tune on the sensitivity pair.
source: First32frozen primary training rows only; no validation/test scoring
